requirements.description: User prefers an energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B, and C. Area (180 sqm), capacity (14 people), location (Turin), and public transport access are not energy columns and are outside this scope.
The user wants the property located near public transport (metro, bus, or train stations). The 'near' wording maps to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. Capacity for 14 people, energy class C or better, and proximity to public transport are not mapped to any reference column and were not converted into filters. The school typology is named in the request, but the provided list of available typologies is empty, so no typology is selected.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 180 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Applies the four extracted requirements: surface_area >= 180; a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892) on latitude/longitude; energy_class in A1-A4, B, C; and mobility >= 71. Results are ordered by distance from the centre point. No property_type predicate is added because the school-type requirement was not among the extracted requirements.
